messages.author: 1a09129d38549286
messages.subject: Re: How to install R, JGR and Deducer in Ubuntu 10.04
parts:
Hi, I'm just new in the list. So, let me first say that I have found
in Deducer a major spur to move from propietary statistical software
to R. Congratulations!

I have followed those guidelines, and encountered an issue with the R
version.

The default version that came in my Ubuntu 10.04 installation was R
2.10.0. According to the Deducer wiki (http://www.deducer.org/pmwiki/
index.php?n=Main.DownloadingAndInstallingDeducer), that should have
worked, so I skipped the step "Install the most recent R version". I
shouldn't.

When I tried to install the 'Deducer' package, it failed due to
unsolved dependencies of the packages 'ggplot2' > 'reshape' > 'plyr'.
Then I learnt that 'plyr' depends on R 2.11.0 or greater. After
upgrading to R 2.13.0, I finally succeeded.

So, Iurie's guidelines are fine, but Deducer's wiki should be updated,
I'm afraid.

Helios
